diagrams.title: From evidence to guidance
diagrams.summary: A verdict results from comparing an identified evidence corpus with an explicit policy.

nodes.label: Assessed subject
nodes.description: Version, environment and scope are identified.

nodes.label: Policy
nodes.description: Criteria and thresholds are applied to the evidence.

nodes.label: Verdict
nodes.description: Compliant, non-compliant or unknown is qualified.

nodes.label: Guidance
nodes.description: Remediation is derived without rewriting the verdict.

diagrams.caption: Missing evidence never becomes implicit success.
